description: The right plot in Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between the Accuracy@1 (%) on geometry problems (Geomverse) and the tree width for rollout search. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)", is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with data points at 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", is a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35. The plot displays two lines: a solid blue line for GPT-4o and a dashed light blue line for Claude-3.5-Sonnet. For GPT-4o, the accuracy starts at 24.4% at a tree width of 1, increases to 28.9% at a tree width of 3, peaks at 34.4% at a tree width of 5, and then decreases to 31.1% at a tree width of 7. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the accuracy starts at 26.7% at a tree width of 1, increases to 27.8% at a tree width of 3, and then decreases to 24.4% at a tree width of 5, and further to 20.0% at a tree width of 7. The plot shows an inverted U-shaped trend for both models, with GPT-4o achieving a higher peak accuracy than Claude-3.5-Sonnet.
